issue: Tauri CLI adds missing tauri-build features=[] on dev/build, leaving tracked Cargo.toml modified and blocking later git pull

root_cause.actual_reproduction: Installed pinned Tauri CLI changed only tauri-build = { version = "=2.7.2" } to include features = [].

fix: Declare features=[] explicitly; keep version/default features unchanged. No Git ignore/assume-unchanged/reset workaround.

checks.fixed_actual_CLI_stability: passed dev/build with LF and CRLF
checks.scope: Real installed CLI on isolated fixture. Fixture intentionally lacks workspace so Cargo metadata exits after normalization; no app/host starts, compiles or downloads. Not a Windows native GUI test.
